asc_inceleme_notu_en: Version 1.74: route videos are now rendered on the device only when the user taps Create video on a ride; the finished video plays in the app and can be saved to Photos or shared. Videos are not uploaded or stored on our servers. The automatic background rendering and the My Videos tab were removed. The app is free; the only in-app purchases are three optional consumable tips under Profile > Support us. Sign in with Apple to test.
